name: mockly-clients-workspace-root
description: npm workspace root tying together the Node client packages that depend on each other's exact versions within this repo (@dever-labs/mockly-driver, its per-platform sub-packages, @dever-labs/mockly-cli, @dever-labs/mockly-testcontainers). This lets npm resolve those intra-repo dependencies via local workspace links instead of the npm registry, so clients/package-lock.json's version fields can be bumped directly via release-please's `extra-files` jsonpath mechanism (see release-please-config.json) and stay consistent with version bumps before the bumped packages are actually published.
